messages:
Rina (Docs): Quick heads-up 1: I'm assembling a very short migration quickstart for the v1 -> v2 API sunset. Need: 1) a bite-sized Python + curl example for embeddings using the new param (model_id), 2) the exact error string users will see on dim mismatch so we can add a one-line troubleshooting tip, and 3) a 1-line changelog blurb we can drop into the release note and console banner. Keep everything minimal 1 (we want one-liners for localization).

Kevin (SDK): I can do that. PR is open: github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/5499. We make model_id the canonical param and accept model as a temporary alias. I'll paste a tiny Python snippet you can embed.

Kevin (SDK): ```py
# python snippet: prefer model_id, fallback to model alias
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RDW_KEY")

alias_map = {"embed-old-512": "embed-new-768"}
requested = "embed-old-512"
model_id = alias_map.get(requested, requested)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model_id=model_id, input=["hello world"])
print(len(resp.data[0]["embedding"]))  # check dim
```

Kevin (SDK): And a curl one-liner:```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"embed-new-768","input":["hi"]}'
```

Alex (Runtime): Two technical notes for the doc: (a) the runtime currently surfaces a 400 with the text "vector_dim" in the message when dims don't line up; we also include an error code "ERR_DIM_MISMATCH" in the machine-readable payload for clients that parse codes. (b) When model families change, KV cache keys may differ 1 recommend calling out "pin your model version for deterministic vectors during rollouts".

Rina (Docs): Good, Alex. Can you paste the exact server error example (short) so I can show it inline? We only need one short line for troubleshooting.

Alex (Runtime): Example response body (short): `{"error":"embedding failed: vector_dim 512 != expected 768", "code":"ERR_DIM_MISMATCH"}`. Use the plain text snippet: "embedding failed: vector_dim" as the string to match in the troubleshooting note.

Rina (Docs): Perfect. I'll add a micro troubleshooting tip: "If you see a 400 mentioning 'vector_dim', verify model_id and remap or regenerate vectors to the expected dimension. Pin model versions during rollouts for identical outputs." Short and localizable.

Priya (L10n): For translations: keep the troubleshooting tip under 120 characters and avoid punctuation-heavy examples. I can localize that one sentence if you put it in the PR description.

Sam (PM): For comms: suggested changelog line: "Embeddings: param rename (model_id) and model aliasing; dim mismatch returns ERR_DIM_MISMATCH — see migration quickstart." Keep it snappy. Rina 1 can we have that displayed in-console as a 1-line banner?

Kevin (SDK): I'll add the changelog blurb to PR 5499 and include the alias_map example in the README.

deploy-bot: Redirect rule created: /docs/embeddings/v1 -> /docs/embeddings/v2 :white_check_mark:

Rina (Docs): Action list (short): 1) Kevin 1 add changelog blurb + README snippet (PR 5499). 2) Alex 1 link the minimal error example in runtime tests and paste link here. 3) Priya 1 queue the one-line troubleshooting sentence for localization when the PR merges. 4) Rina 1 add Python + curl examples + the troubleshooting sentence to the migration quickstart and open the docs PR.

Kevin (SDK): Assigned. Aiming to land the SDK README and changelog update today.

Alex (Runtime): I'll push the tiny test and paste the CI link in this thread when it's green.

Rina (Docs): Thanks everyone 1 Once both PRs are green I'll merge the doc patch and trigger the translation job.

(End)
